_meta.description: Philippine IT/business career market data for Navi career recommendation engine
sources: Jobstreet Philippines Career Advice (ph.jobstreet.com/career-advice) — primary source for PH monthly salary ranges, accessed June 2026
PayScale Philippines (payscale.com/research/PH) — supplementary, annual total compensation by experience level
Glassdoor Philippines salary estimates (glassdoor.com) — supplementary, percentile pay ranges
ERI SalaryExpert (salaryexpert.com / erieri.com) — supplementary, employer-reported survey data
_meta.notes: Salary ranges reflect the Jobstreet 'average salary' band reported for the Philippines as of mid-2026, which is based on disclosed salaries in active job postings. These are entry-to-mid level market averages, not senior/expert compensation. Demand levels are qualitative assessments based on relative job posting volume observed across Jobstreet, Indeed PH, and Glassdoor during research, combined with industry growth commentary. This dataset should be periodically refreshed as it reflects a snapshot in time.
_meta.matching_guidance: This dataset is intentionally wider than a typical 'top 3' career quiz so the recommendation engine (Gemini) can surface careers the student did not expect, not just the most obvious title match. Each career includes 'interest_tags' (the underlying motivations/activities the role satisfies) and 'work_style_tags' (how the day-to-day actually feels) in addition to 'related_skills' (concrete tools/competencies). When generating recommendations, match the student's quiz answers and free-text feedback against interest_tags and work_style_tags first — these capture transferable fit even when the student has never heard of the job title — then use related_skills and category to explain the reasoning and surface skill gaps. 'discoverable: true' marks careers that are intentionally less obvious for a Service Management / Business Analytics IT student but are realistic next steps given their academic foundation; the AI should not hesitate to recommend these when the fit is genuinely strong, even if the student never selected them as a known interest.

careers.title: Service Manager
careers.salary_note: Jobstreet PH average for 'IT Manager' is ₱70,000–₱80,000/mo; broader IT Service Management roles (e.g. IT Project Manager) average ₱85,000–₱95,000/mo. Range reflects this band.
careers.demand_note: Consistently high posting volume across Taguig, Makati, Pasig, Manila, and Quezon City; strong presence in BPO/GCC and outsourcing sectors.
interest_tags: being the point person during a crisis
careers.typical_education: Bachelor's degree in IT, Business Administration, or related field

careers.title: Business Analyst
careers.salary_note: Jobstreet PH average for 'Business Analyst' is ₱48,000–₱58,000/mo; 'IT Business Analyst' (more technical variant) averages ₱66,000–₱76,000/mo.
careers.demand_note: High and steady posting volume, especially in BPO, IT outsourcing, banking, and shared services sectors.
careers.typical_education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, IT, or related field

careers.title: Data Analyst
careers.salary_note: Jobstreet PH average for 'Data Analyst' is ₱33,000–₱43,000/mo. Business Intelligence Analyst (closely related, slightly senior variant) averages ₱50,000–₱60,000/mo.
careers.demand_note: Very high entry-level demand, frequently cited as a common entry point into the broader data field in PH job postings.
careers.typical_education: Bachelor's degree in IT, Statistics, Mathematics, or related field

careers.title: Project Manager
careers.salary_note: Jobstreet PH average for general 'Project Manager' is ₱50,000–₱60,000/mo; 'IT Project Manager' specifically averages ₱85,000–₱95,000/mo, reflecting higher pay for technical project leadership.
careers.demand_note: Strong, sustained demand across IT outsourcing, construction-adjacent tech, and enterprise digital transformation projects.
interest_tags: leading and organizing teams or projects
careers.typical_education: Bachelor's degree in IT, Engineering, or Business; PMP certification advantageous

careers.title: UX Designer
careers.salary_note: Jobstreet PH average for 'User Experience Designer' is ₱70,000–₱80,000/mo; the more UI-focused 'User Interface Designer' role averages lower, at ₱38,000–₱48,000/mo. Range spans both.
careers.demand_note: Growing demand tied to digital product and fintech growth in PH; strong freelance/remote international client market as well.
interest_tags: designing and creating visuals or ideas
understanding how people think and behave
careers.typical_education: Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, IT, or related field; portfolio required

careers.title: Systems Analyst
careers.salary_note: Jobstreet PH average for 'Systems Analyst' is ₱33,000–₱43,000/mo, similar in range to Data Analyst roles; senior Business Systems Analyst roles trend toward the higher end.
careers.demand_note: Consistent demand in enterprise IT departments and outsourcing firms supporting system integration and maintenance.
interest_tags: translating business needs into technical specs
careers.typical_education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field

careers.title: Data Scientist
careers.salary_note: Jobstreet PH average for 'Data Scientist' is ₱80,000–₱90,000/mo. Range widened to reflect entry-level postings starting near ₱60,000/mo and senior/specialized roles (AI & Analytics Specialist) reaching ₱120,000/mo based on PayScale and ERI survey data.
careers.demand_note: Fast-growing demand driven by AI/ML adoption among PH-based GCCs (e.g. eCloudvalley, shared services centers); among the more competitive and well-compensated data roles.
careers.typical_education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or related field

careers.title: Scrum Master
careers.salary_note: Jobstreet PH active postings show ₱60,000–₱70,000/mo base for mid-level (2+ yrs exp) Scrum Master roles in IT outsourcing firms; Paylab PH survey shows 80% of Scrum Masters earning ₱36,000–₱123,000/mo, supporting a wide entry-to-mid band.
careers.demand_note: Steady demand concentrated in IT outsourcing and software delivery teams using Agile; smaller talent pool than PM/BA roles but consistently posted in Metro Manila.
interest_tags: leading and organizing teams or projects
helping a team work better together
careers.typical_education: Bachelor's degree in IT, Business, or related field; Scrum Master certification (CSM/PSM) highly valued though not always required

careers.title: Product Owner
careers.salary_note: Jobstreet PH average for 'Product Owner' is ₱73,000–₱83,000/mo, based on active job postings as of June 2026.
careers.demand_note: Growing role as PH-based teams take on more product (not just delivery/outsourcing) responsibility for global companies; moderate but rising posting volume.
interest_tags: deciding what gets built and why
balancing business needs with user needs
careers.typical_education: Bachelor's degree in Business, IT, or related field; Product Owner certification (CSPO) advantageous

careers.title: QA Analyst
careers.salary_note: Jobstreet PH average for 'Quality Assurance Analyst' is ₱21,000–₱31,000/mo and 'Quality Analyst' is ₱28,000–₱38,000/mo; NodeFlair PH survey places median QA/Testing pay higher at ₱58,000/mo, reflecting that automation/technical QA roles pay notably more than manual/process QA.
careers.demand_note: Very high posting volume across BPO and software outsourcing firms; one of the more accessible entry points into tech for IT students who enjoy structured, detail-oriented work.
interest_tags: finding what's broken before users do
careers.typical_education: Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field; ISTQB certification advantageous for technical QA roles

careers.title: IT Auditor
careers.salary_note: Entry-level GRC/IT Auditor roles in PH typically range ₱25,000–₱50,000/mo per recent cybersecurity-career-track reporting; ERI survey data (which skews toward senior/expert respondents) shows considerably higher averages, so the entry-level Jobstreet-comparable band is used here.
careers.demand_note: Steady demand from banks, Big 4 audit firms, and BPOs needing to demonstrate compliance (data privacy, SOX, ISO 27001); a less crowded niche than general BA/PM roles.
interest_tags: making sure rules and processes are followed
spotting risk before it becomes a problem
careers.typical_education: Bachelor's degree in IT, Accounting, or related field; certifications like CISA valued for career growth

careers.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
careers.salary_note: Entry-level (0-2 yrs) SOC L1/junior security analyst roles in PH range ₱25,000–₱50,000/mo per 2026 cybersecurity career-track reporting, with BPO security delivery roles (Accenture, Concentrix) at the higher end due to night-shift premiums and USD client billing.
careers.demand_note: Rapidly growing demand driven by bank, telco, and BPO security operations centers (SOCs); widely cited as one of the fastest-growing PH tech career tracks in 2026.
careers.typical_education: Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field; CompTIA Security+ is the most commonly required entry-level certification in PH job postings

careers.title: ERP Consultant
careers.salary_note: ERI survey data shows ERP Consultant as one of the lower-paid specializations among IT business-systems titles in PH relative to peers like Business Systems Analyst, but active Jobstreet postings for 'PSA Functional Consultant / Sr. Business Analyst' roles suggest a healthy ₱45,000–₱80,000/mo band for PH-based functional consulting work.
careers.demand_note: Consistent demand from companies running SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics implementations; a natural extension for Business Analytics students who enjoy configuring systems to match business processes.
interest_tags: configuring systems to fit a business
specializing in a major enterprise platform
careers.typical_education: Bachelor's degree in IT, Business Administration, or related field; vendor certifications (SAP, Oracle) valuable for career growth
